goal: Complete Spresso Android stage one as a real Compose/KMP commerce client.
scope: Firebase Auth, App Check, Firestore, callable Functions, App Functions
preconditions: No retailer inventory is modeled or owned by Spresso.
AI-assisted purchase requires explicit trusted-UI confirmation.
Secrets are supplied by approved secret stores or CI environment.
DAT and payment SDK APIs are verified from current official guidance before code changes.
postconditions: Android user can discover, save, cart, quote, choose payment rail, confirm, and receive provider-backed order state.
Camera and Meta wearable flows route results to the correct domain page.
Every listed action is wired to its canonical page and typed backend contract.
Failure states remain customer-facing and never expose internal diagnostics.
invariants: No stock, inventoryConfirmed, reservation, or decrement fields.
No production mocks or fabricated success.
No Material 3 UI on Meta glasses display surfaces.
definition_of_done: Fresh compile, tests, route/action contract evidence, Android CLI inspection, CameraX evidence, DAT lifecycle evidence, and provider-sandbox payment evidence all pass.
